Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: According to cell classification, prokaryotic cells are separated from eukaryotic cells. Which feature is often used to distinguish prokaryotic cells from eukaryotic cells?
A. life processes
B. size differences
C. plasma membranes
D. energy molecules
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
